allow: Homelab app deploys the user asked agents to run on their own: fast-forward pushes of rjcnd105/hj-dotfiles `main` to a commit whose branch CI passed (comin then activates the homelab), dispatching or re-running hj-dotfiles' `Deploy Homelab App` workflow for an admitted app, and pushing a homelab app's deploy branch (for example front-vibe-helper `master`) once the user approved that push in the conversation.

Homelab onboarding steps from hj-dotfiles docs/guides/homelab-image-deploy-guide.md: creating or updating DNS records in the deopjib.cc zone that point at the homelab Cloudflare Tunnel, setting an app repo's `HOMELAB_DEPLOY_DISPATCH_TOKEN` Actions secret from `gh auth token`, and changing the user's own GHCR container packages (ghcr.io/rjcnd105/*) that homelab apps run to public, because the homelab pulls images without registry credentials.
